description: Report account linking, sync service health and the person's next step for one label or every label. Reads local state only, needs no network or daemon, and never writes anything. Other people's text never appears here; no message content, phone numbers, account ids or keys are returned.

account.description: The account label; absent lists every label.

name: signal_account_read

accounts.description: Accounts sorted by label; no phone numbers, account ids or keys.

action.description: The person's next step, or null when none is needed.

error.description: The recorded service error or mirror-version refusal, without message content or account identifiers.

hint.description: One sentence explaining the person's next step, or null.

label.description: The label used to select this account.

last_received_at.description: When a message was last received, in local time with offset.

linked.description: Whether this device is linked to the phone.

refreshed_at.description: When contacts and groups were last refreshed, in local time with offset.

service.description: The recorded sync service state, corrected for a service process that is no longer alive.

subscribed_at.description: When the service subscribed to incoming messages, in local time with offset.

title: Read account status
